sourceHeader.keywords: Hijutsu, Ninjutsu, Genjutsu (Auditory, Tactile), Fuinjutsu, Bio Amphibian.

system.description:
Your throat begins to shift and transfigure into a replication of your Bio-Pets as your vocal cords begin to vibrate, creating a song that sends all those that hear it into a catatonic state. All creatures of your choice in range, that can hear you, when this jutsu is cast, must make a Wisdom saving throw.

Critical Success: As part of passing, they cover their ears and Deafen themselves. This counts as willingly deafening themselves avoiding the beginning of the song. A creature that critically succeeds this jutsu cannot be affected by it again

Success: Affected creature becomes Confused and Charmed, being unable to harm or target the caster of this jutsu until the end of their next turn.

Failure: Affected creatures thoughts are overwritten with thoughts of pleasure and joy, becoming Blinded, Deafened to all sounds except those coming from you and Confused for the duration. A creature under the effect of this jutsu can remake their saving throw once per turn, if a creature allied to them spends their Bonus action to shake them or they take damage.

Critical Failure: Same as failure, but they can only remake their saving throw if they take damage and cannot be shaken to help break them free.
